name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
tagline: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year for farmer families
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
description: PM-KISAN provides income support to all landholding farmer families in the country to enable them to take care of expenses related to agriculture and allied activities as well as domestic needs. ₹6,000 per year is transferred directly into bank accounts in three equal installments of ₹2,000 every 4 months.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year direct financial benefit
Paid in 3 equal four-monthly installments of ₹2,000 each
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank account
Access to Kisan Credit Card (KCC) loan facilities at subsidized interest

specialConditions: Must own cultivable agricultural land registered in land records
Excludes institutional landholders, serving/retired government employees, and income tax payees

eligibilitySummary: Small and marginal landholding farmer families
Cultivable agricultural land must be in the applicant's name
Bank account must be Aadhaar-linked and DBT-enabled via NPCI
Cannot be a current or retired government employee or income tax payer

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar Card
documentsRequired.description: Mandatory for identity verification and biometric eKYC

documentsRequired.name: Land Ownership Records (Khatauni / RoR / 7/12 extract)
documentsRequired.description: Updated land record showing applicant as owner of cultivable land

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar-Seeded Bank Passbook / Account Details
documentsRequired.description: Bank account number with IFSC code; must be mapped to NPCI for DBT

documentsRequired.name: Active Mobile Number
documentsRequired.description: Linked with Aadhaar to receive OTPs during registration and e-KYC

applicationProcedure.title: Visit PM-KISAN Portal
applicationProcedure.detail: Open official website https://pmkisan.gov.in and click on "New Farmer Registration" under Farmers Corner.

applicationProcedure.title: Select Registration Type
applicationProcedure.detail: Choose between Rural Farmer Registration or Urban Farmer Registration. Enter Aadhaar Number and select your State.

applicationProcedure.title: Aadhaar OTP Verification
applicationProcedure.detail: Enter the OTP received on your Aadhaar-registered mobile number and submit.

applicationProcedure.title: Fill Land and Personal Details
applicationProcedure.detail: Enter personal information, land survey/khasra number, khatauni details, land size, and bank details.

applicationProcedure.title: Upload Land Documents and Submit
applicationProcedure.detail: Upload scanned copy of land ownership certificate (PDF < 200KB) and click submit. Save your Application Reference ID.

applicationProcedure.title: Complete Biometric/OTP eKYC
applicationProcedure.detail: Complete eKYC via OTP on the portal or visit nearest CSC center for biometric fingerprint authentication.

troubleshootingTips.issue: eKYC not working or OTP not received
troubleshootingTips.solution: Ensure mobile number is linked to Aadhaar on UIDAI. Alternatively, visit your nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) for biometric eKYC.

troubleshootingTips.issue: Installment stopped or rejected (FTO not generated)
troubleshootingTips.solution: Check "Beneficiary Status" on the portal. Common causes: Land records unverified by State Patwari, or Bank account not NPCI Aadhaar-seeded. Visit your bank branch to submit Aadhaar DBT consent form.

troubleshootingTips.issue: Name mismatch between Aadhaar and Land Records
troubleshootingTips.solution: Click "Edit Aadhaar Details" on the portal or visit the local block agriculture office / Tehsildar.

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
tagline: Free health insurance cover of up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare / National Health Authority (NHA)
description: PM-JAY is the world's largest government-funded health assurance scheme. It provides a health cover of ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to over 12 crore poor and vulnerable families (bottom 40% of the population) across empaneled public and private hospitals across India.
benefits: Cashless and paperless treatment up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year
Covers 1,949 medical and surgical procedures, surgeries, and ICU care
Includes 3 days pre-hospitalization and 15 days post-hospitalization medicines & diagnostic tests
Portability across all 28,000+ empaneled government and private hospitals across India
Senior citizens aged 70+ now receive a separate top-up ₹5 Lakh cover regardless of income

specialConditions: Households identified under Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC 2011) deprivation criteria or active National Food Security Act (NFSA) ration card holders
All citizens aged 70 and above qualify for the new Ayushman Vay Vandana card irrespective of economic status

eligibilitySummary: Families categorized as poor or vulnerable in SECC 2011 data / Ration Card holders
Occupational categories: ragpickers, beggars, domestic workers, street vendors, construction workers, rickshaw pullers
All senior citizens aged 70+ are now automatically eligible under expanded PM-JAY

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar Card
documentsRequired.description: Primary ID and for biometric/OTP e-KYC

documentsRequired.name: Ration Card / NFSA Card
documentsRequired.description: Proof of family composition and socioeconomic eligibility

documentsRequired.name: Active Mobile Number
documentsRequired.description: For OTP verification during card generation

documentsRequired.name: Government ID with address
documentsRequired.description: Voter ID or Domicile if address proof differs

applicationProcedure.title: Check Eligibility Online
applicationProcedure.detail: Visit https://beneficiary.nha.gov.in or download the Ayushman App on your smartphone.

applicationProcedure.title: Login with Mobile Number
applicationProcedure.detail: Select "Beneficiary", enter your mobile number, verify with OTP and captcha.

applicationProcedure.title: Search Family Records
applicationProcedure.detail: Select your State, Scheme (PMJAY), and search by Family ID (Ration Card), Aadhaar Number, or Location.

applicationProcedure.title: Complete e-KYC
applicationProcedure.detail: For family members showing "e-KYC Pending", click on the icon, authenticate via Aadhaar OTP, IRIS, or Fingerprint, and capture a live photograph.

applicationProcedure.title: Download Ayushman Card (PVC/PDF)
applicationProcedure.detail: Once approved (often within minutes or 24 hours), click "Download Card" to receive your digital Ayushman Golden Card.

troubleshootingTips.issue: Name not showing in beneficiary list
troubleshootingTips.solution: Search by Ration Card number rather than name. If your family has an NFSA BPL/Antyodaya card, visit your local Ayushman Mitra at any district civil hospital.

troubleshootingTips.issue: Card approval pending for days
troubleshootingTips.solution: Check if your live photo is clear and matches Aadhaar. Re-attempt eKYC via the Ayushman App with proper lighting or visit a CSC kiosk.

troubleshootingTips.issue: Hospital refusing cashless treatment
troubleshootingTips.solution: Contact the on-site Ayushman Mitra desk at the hospital immediately or dial national toll-free number 14555 to register an urgent grievance.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
tagline: Collateral-free business loans up to ₹20 Lakh for micro & small enterprises
ministry: Ministry of Finance / Department of Financial Services
description: PMMY provides institutional collateral-free loans to micro and small non-farm enterprises engaged in manufacturing, trading, and service activities. Loans are offered across four tiers: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakh), Tarun (₹5 Lakh to ₹10 Lakh), and the recently expanded Tarun Plus (₹10 Lakh to ₹20 Lakh).
benefits: No collateral or third-party guarantee required
Affordable interest rates linked to RBI guidelines
Shishu loan: up to ₹50,000 for starting small vendor/shop activities
Kishore loan: ₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakh for expanding business
Tarun & Tarun Plus: ₹5 Lakh up to ₹20 Lakh for established micro enterprises
Comes with a Mudra Debit Card for working capital withdrawals

specialConditions: Must have a viable business proposal in non-farm sector
Should not be a defaulter with any bank or financial institution

eligibilitySummary: Any Indian citizen having a business idea or existing micro-enterprise in non-farm sector
Age between 18 and 65 years
Clean credit history with no past bank loan default

documentsRequired.name: Identity Proof (Aadhaar / PAN Card / Voter ID)
documentsRequired.description: Government verified photo identity

documentsRequired.name: Address Proof
documentsRequired.description: Utility bill, Aadhaar, or Domicile certificate

documentsRequired.name: Business Proof / Enterprise Registration
documentsRequired.description: Udyam Registration certificate, Shop & Establishment license, or GSTIN (for Kishore/Tarun)

documentsRequired.name: Bank Statement
documentsRequired.description: Last 6 to 12 months bank statement of personal/business account

documentsRequired.name: Project Report / Quotation of Machinery
documentsRequired.description: Brief business plan detailing estimated cost, revenue, and working capital needs

applicationProcedure.title: Prepare Business Proposal
applicationProcedure.detail: Outline your business activity, machinery purchase quotation, or inventory requirements.

applicationProcedure.title: Visit Udyamimitra Portal
applicationProcedure.detail: Go to https://www.udyamimitra.in or JanSamarth portal https://www.jansamarth.in

applicationProcedure.title: Register and Check Loan Category
applicationProcedure.detail: Choose your tier: Shishu (<₹50K), Kishore (<₹5L), or Tarun (<₹20L).

applicationProcedure.title: Upload KYC and Business Documents
applicationProcedure.detail: Fill applicant profile, upload PAN, Aadhaar, bank statements, and Udyam certificate.

applicationProcedure.title: Select Preferred Lender
applicationProcedure.detail: Choose participating public sector banks, private banks, RRBs, or NBFCs.

applicationProcedure.title: Verification and Sanction
applicationProcedure.detail: Bank branch reviews application, verifies documents, and disburses loan into your current/savings account.

troubleshootingTips.issue: Bank demanding collateral/guarantee for Mudra loan
troubleshootingTips.solution: Mudra loans are strictly collateral-free under Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units (CGFMU). Quote RBI Circular or apply via the JanSamarth digital portal where terms are transparent.

troubleshootingTips.issue: Application pending at bank branch
troubleshootingTips.solution: Track status on JanSamarth portal. If delayed past 3 weeks without reason, escalate to the Lead District Manager (LDM) or file an online grievance on CPGRAMS.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin
tagline: Financial assistance of up to ₹1.20 - ₹1.30 Lakh to build a pucca house in rural India
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: PMAY-G aims to provide a pucca house with basic amenities to all rural families living in kutcha or dilapidated houses. The beneficiary gets financial assistance directly deposited into their bank account in installments linked to construction stages, along with 90/95 days of unskilled labor wages under MGNREGA and ₹12,000 for toilet construction under SBM-G.
benefits: ₹1,20,000 in plain areas / ₹1,30,000 in hilly/northeast/Himalayan states
Additional 90 to 95 days of employment wages under MGNREGA (~₹20,000+)
₹12,000 additional assistance for toilet construction via Swachh Bharat Mission
Free electricity connection under Saubhagya and LPG cylinder under Ujjwala
Minimum house size 25 sq. meters including a hygienic cooking area

specialConditions: Must reside in rural area and have no pucca house anywhere in India
Identified in Awaas+ survey or SECC 2011 housing deprivation list

eligibilitySummary: Rural households with no house or living in zero/one/two room kutcha houses with kutcha roof and wall
Households without any literate adult above 25 years or without adult male member 16-59 years
Female-headed households or households with disabled members

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar Card of all family members
documentsRequired.description: For identity and biometric linking

documentsRequired.name: MGNREGA Job Card Number
documentsRequired.description: Required to map 90/95 days labor subsidy directly

documentsRequired.name: Bank Account Passbook (Aadhaar linked)
documentsRequired.description: To receive construction milestone disbursements

documentsRequired.name: Land / Homestead Patta document
documentsRequired.description: Proof of land where house is to be constructed

documentsRequired.name: Consent letter for Aadhaar usage
documentsRequired.description: Standard declaration

applicationProcedure.title: Identification via Gram Sabha
applicationProcedure.detail: Eligible beneficiaries are selected by Gram Sabha from the Awaas+ 2024 survey and SECC list.

applicationProcedure.title: Registration on AwaasSoft
applicationProcedure.detail: Block Development Officer (BDO) or Gram Panchayat Panchayat Sachiv enters beneficiary details on AwaasSoft portal.

applicationProcedure.title: Geo-tagging of Existing Kutcha Site
applicationProcedure.detail: Gram Rozgar Sahayak takes a geo-tagged photograph of the current site using AwaasApp.

applicationProcedure.title: First Installment Release
applicationProcedure.detail: Sanction letter is issued and 1st installment (25%) transferred via PFMS directly to bank account.

applicationProcedure.title: Progressive Construction & Verification
applicationProcedure.detail: Further installments are released upon geo-tagged photo uploads of foundation, plinth, and roof level.

troubleshootingTips.issue: Installment delayed after foundation stage
troubleshootingTips.solution: Contact your Gram Panchayat Sachiv to re-upload the geo-tagged inspection photo on AwaasApp. If the photo was rejected for blurriness, it must be retaken.

troubleshootingTips.issue: Bank account changed or DBT failed
troubleshootingTips.solution: Submit updated bank passbook and Aadhaar linkage consent to Block Development Office (BDO) to update PFMS record.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
tagline: High interest (8.2% p.a.) savings scheme for the girl child with full tax exemption
ministry: Ministry of Finance / Department of Posts
description: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana is a government-backed small deposit savings scheme formulated exclusively for the welfare and higher education of the girl child. Accounts can be opened by parents/legal guardians from the birth of the girl child up to the age of 10 years. It offers one of the highest interest rates among small savings instruments (8.2% compounded annually) and Section 80C tax exemption (EEE status).
benefits: High guaranteed interest rate: 8.2% p.a. (compounded annually)
Triple tax benefit (EEE: Exempt, Exempt, Exempt on deposit, interest, and maturity) under Section 80C
Flexible deposit: Minimum ₹250 up to maximum ₹1,50,000 per financial year
Partial withdrawal up to 50% allowed after age 18 for higher education / university admission
Account matures 21 years from opening date or on the girl child's marriage after age 18

specialConditions: Account must be opened before girl child turns 10 years of age
Maximum 2 accounts per family (one for each girl child; 3 allowed in case of firstborn or second-born twins)

eligibilitySummary: Girl child must be an Indian resident under 10 years of age
Can be opened by parent or legal guardian in any Post Office or authorized commercial bank branch

documentsRequired.name: Birth Certificate of Girl Child
documentsRequired.description: Mandatory certificate issued by municipal body or hospital

documentsRequired.name: Identity Proof of Parent/Guardian
documentsRequired.description: Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, or Passport

documentsRequired.name: Address Proof of Parent/Guardian
documentsRequired.description: Aadhaar Card, Electricity Bill, or Ration Card

documentsRequired.name: Passport Size Photographs
documentsRequired.description: Two recent photos of parent/guardian and girl child

applicationProcedure.title: Download or Collect Form
applicationProcedure.detail: Collect the SSY Account Opening Form from any India Post Office branch or authorized bank (SBI, PNB, BoB, Canara, HDFC, ICICI, etc.) or download online.

applicationProcedure.title: Fill Application Details
applicationProcedure.detail: Fill girl child details, parent KYC details, initial deposit amount (minimum ₹250).

applicationProcedure.title: Attach Documents
applicationProcedure.detail: Enclose child's birth certificate, guardian's Aadhaar, PAN card, and address proof.

applicationProcedure.title: Deposit Initial Cash/Cheque
applicationProcedure.detail: Submit the application along with cash or cheque for initial deposit.

applicationProcedure.title: Receive Passbook
applicationProcedure.detail: The post office/bank will issue an official SSY Passbook with account number and interest tracking.

troubleshootingTips.issue: Missed minimum annual deposit of ₹250
troubleshootingTips.solution: The account becomes dormant. You can regularize it by paying a minimal penalty fee of ₹50 along with the minimum deposit of ₹250 for each default year.

troubleshootingTips.issue: Transferring account across cities
troubleshootingTips.solution: SSY accounts are 100% transferable across any Post Office or bank anywhere in India free of cost upon submitting a transfer request form.

name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
tagline: End-to-end support, ₹15,000 toolkit grant & subsidized loans for traditional artisans & craftspeople
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
description: PM Vishwakarma provides comprehensive institutional support to traditional artisans and craftspeople who work with their hands and tools. Covers 18 traditional trades including carpenters, boat makers, blacksmiths, goldsmiths, potters, cobblers, tailors, and masons with skill training, daily stipends, modern toolkits, and collateral-free enterprise credit at an effective 5% interest rate.
benefits: PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID card as certified artisan
Basic skill training (5-7 days) & Advanced training (15 days) with ₹500/day stipend
Modern Toolkit Incentive of ₹15,000 e-voucher
Collateral-free Enterprise Credit: ₹1 Lakh (1st tranche) & ₹2 Lakh (2nd tranche) at concessional 5% interest
Incentive for digital transactions (₹1 per transaction up to 100 transactions/month)
National marketing and branding support on GeM (Government e-Marketplace)
benefitAmount: ₹15,000 toolkit voucher + up to ₹3 Lakh low-interest loan

specialConditions: Must be practicing one of the 18 eligible traditional family-based craft trades
Should not have availed similar credit-based schemes like PMEGP or Mudra in past 5 years
Benefit restricted to one member per family

eligibilitySummary: Artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools in one of 18 traditional trades
Minimum age 18 years on date of application
Family member not working in government service

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar Card
documentsRequired.description: Mandatory for biometric eKYC verification

documentsRequired.name: Active Mobile Number
documentsRequired.description: Linked with Aadhaar to receive OTPs

documentsRequired.name: Bank Account Passbook
documentsRequired.description: For credit disbursement and stipend transfer

documentsRequired.name: Ration Card
documentsRequired.description: To verify family composition (one per family rule)

documentsRequired.name: Skill / Trade Details
documentsRequired.description: Details of your craft activity and experience

applicationProcedure.title: Visit Nearest CSC Center
applicationProcedure.detail: Beneficiary registration for PM Vishwakarma must be completed via Common Service Centre (CSC) with biometric authentication.

applicationProcedure.title: Biometric e-KYC Verification
applicationProcedure.detail: CSC VLE verifies applicant Aadhaar through fingerprint or iris scan on https://pmvishwakarma.gov.in.

applicationProcedure.title: Select Your Trade from 18 Eligible Crafts
applicationProcedure.detail: Select your trade (e.g., Darzi/Tailor, Suthar/Carpenter, Kumbhaar/Potter, Rajmistri/Mason).

applicationProcedure.title: Three-Stage Verification
applicationProcedure.detail: Stage 1: Gram Panchayat or Urban Local Body verification. Stage 2: District Implementation Committee. Stage 3: National Screening Committee.

applicationProcedure.title: Skill Training & Toolkit E-Voucher
applicationProcedure.detail: Attend 5-day training at designated ITI/center, receive ₹500/day stipend, and get ₹15,000 voucher for toolkit.

applicationProcedure.title: Avail Subsidized Credit
applicationProcedure.detail: Apply for 1st tranche loan of ₹1,00,000 at 5% interest rate directly through the portal.

troubleshootingTips.issue: Application stuck at Gram Panchayat level
troubleshootingTips.solution: Contact your Village Panchayat Secretary or Ward Councillor with your Application Reference Number for pending approval.

troubleshootingTips.issue: Toolkit voucher not received after training
troubleshootingTips.solution: Check your registered mobile number for SMS with e-RUPI voucher link or download certificate from PM Vishwakarma portal.

name: Atal Pension Yojana
tagline: Guaranteed lifetime monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 after age 60
ministry: Ministry of Finance / PFRDA
description: Atal Pension Yojana is a government-guaranteed pension scheme targeted at workers in the unorganized sector. Subscribers contribute a nominal monthly amount starting from age 18 to 40 and receive a guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 from age 60 until death, followed by same pension to spouse, and return of full accumulated corpus to the nominee.
benefits: Guaranteed lifelong monthly pension (₹1,000 to ₹5,000/month)
Same pension continues to spouse upon demise of subscriber
Return of full accumulated pension wealth to nominee after demise of spouse
Low monthly contribution: Starting as low as ₹42/month (for ₹1,000 pension at age 18) or ₹210/month (for ₹5,000 pension at age 18)
Government guarantees returns if corpus falls short of targeted payout

specialConditions: Must be an Indian citizen aged between 18 and 40 years
Should possess a savings bank account with auto-debit facility
Cannot be an income tax payer (as per rules effective October 2022)

eligibilitySummary: Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 years
Having a savings bank account or post office account
Not an income tax payer

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar Card
documentsRequired.description: For KYC and demographic details

documentsRequired.name: Active Bank / Post Office Account
documentsRequired.description: With auto-debit facility enabled for monthly/quarterly contribution

documentsRequired.name: Active Mobile Number
documentsRequired.description: For monthly deduction alerts and PRAN generation

documentsRequired.name: Nominee Information
documentsRequired.description: Spouse Aadhaar and nominee details

applicationProcedure.title: Visit Bank Branch or Net Banking
applicationProcedure.detail: Approach your bank branch where you have an account or login to Net Banking / Mobile Banking app.

applicationProcedure.title: Search Atal Pension Yojana
applicationProcedure.detail: Navigate to "Social Security Schemes" or "Government Schemes" -> APY.

applicationProcedure.title: Choose Pension Amount
applicationProcedure.detail: Select your desired pension slab (₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000/month).

applicationProcedure.title: Set Auto-Debit Frequency
applicationProcedure.detail: Select auto-debit frequency (monthly, quarterly, or half-yearly) and provide nominee details.

applicationProcedure.title: PRAN Generation
applicationProcedure.detail: Upon submission, a Permanent Retirement Account Number (PRAN) is issued and e-PRAN card can be downloaded from NSDL portal.

troubleshootingTips.issue: Missed monthly auto-debit due to insufficient balance
troubleshootingTips.solution: A nominal overdue penalty of ₹1 per ₹100 per month is charged. Simply fund your savings account before the next auto-debit cycle to restore active status.

troubleshootingTips.issue: How to download e-PRAN card
troubleshootingTips.solution: Visit https://www.npscra.nsdl.co.in/scheme-details.php, click "e-PRAN / Transaction Statement for APY", enter your PRAN or Bank Account Number and Date of Birth.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi
tagline: Working capital micro-loans up to ₹50,000 for street vendors with cashback on digital payments
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)
description: PM SVANidhi is a special micro-credit facility empowering urban, peri-urban, and rural street vendors who operate in urban areas. Provides initial working capital collateral-free loan of ₹10,000 (1st tranche), upon timely repayment eligible for ₹20,000 (2nd tranche), and up to ₹50,000 (3rd tranche) with 7% interest subsidy and up to ₹1,200 annual cashback on digital transactions.
benefits: Collateral-free working capital: ₹10,000 -> ₹20,000 -> ₹50,000
7% annual interest subsidy credited quarterly directly to bank account
Up to ₹1,200/year cashback for adopting digital payments (QR code)
No prepayment penalty; early repayment unlocks higher next tranche loan
Enables formal credit score creation for informal street vendors

specialConditions: Vendors with Certificate of Vending (CoV) / ID Card issued by Urban Local Bodies (ULB)
Vendors identified in survey or possessing Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from Town Vending Committee (TVC)

eligibilitySummary: Street vendors engaged in vending in urban areas on or before March 2020 (or identified in subsequent ULB surveys)
Possess a Certificate of Vending or Letter of Recommendation from local municipality/ULB

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar Card
documentsRequired.description: For identity and biometric verification

documentsRequired.name: Vending Certificate / Identity Card / LoR
documentsRequired.description: Issued by Municipality / Nagar Nigam / Town Vending Committee

documentsRequired.name: Bank Account Passbook
documentsRequired.description: Aadhaar linked account for loan disbursal

documentsRequired.name: Active Mobile Number
documentsRequired.description: Linked with Aadhaar

applicationProcedure.title: Check Vendor Status on Portal
applicationProcedure.detail: Visit https://pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in and click "Apply for Loan".

applicationProcedure.title: Verify Mobile Number
applicationProcedure.detail: Enter Aadhaar-linked mobile number and verify via OTP.

applicationProcedure.title: Select Vending Category
applicationProcedure.detail: Choose whether you hold a Vending Card (CoV) or need a Letter of Recommendation (LoR).

applicationProcedure.title: Select Preferred Bank/Lender
applicationProcedure.detail: Pick your preferred nearby bank branch, small finance bank, or NBFC.

applicationProcedure.title: Digital Disbursal
applicationProcedure.detail: Loan is sanctioned and credited into your account within 7 to 14 days without any collateral.

troubleshootingTips.issue: Vendor doesn't have Certificate of Vending
troubleshootingTips.solution: Click "Apply for Letter of Recommendation (LoR)" on the portal. The Town Vending Committee / Municipal Ward Officer verifies your vending spot and issues an LoR within 15 days.

troubleshootingTips.issue: How to claim 7% interest subsidy and cashback
troubleshootingTips.solution: Pay monthly EMIs on time via auto-debit and use the QR code provided by the bank for customer payments.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
tagline: ₹5,000 for first child & ₹6,000 for second girl child direct cash incentive for mothers
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: PMMVY is a conditional cash transfer maternity benefit scheme providing compensation for partial wage loss to pregnant women and lactating mothers so they can take adequate rest before and after delivery, while promoting institutional delivery and child immunization.
benefits: ₹5,000 for 1st live child in 2 installments (₹3,000 on early pregnancy registration & ANC, ₹2,000 upon child birth registration & first cycle vaccination)
₹6,000 in single installment if the second child is a girl to encourage girl child ratio
Direct Benefit Transfer directly into mother's Aadhaar-linked bank account

specialConditions: Pregnant Women and Lactating Mothers (PW&LM)
Excludes regular central or state government employees or PSU employees who receive paid maternity leave

eligibilitySummary: Pregnant women who registered pregnancy at Anganwadi / Health center
Belong to socially/economically disadvantaged groups (EWS, SC/ST, BPL Ration Card, MGNREGA Job Card holders, Divyang, etc.)

documentsRequired.name: Mother's Aadhaar Card
documentsRequired.description: Primary ID (mandatory for DBT)

documentsRequired.name: Husband / Father's Aadhaar Card
documentsRequired.description: For record

documentsRequired.name: Mother and Child Protection (MCP) Card
documentsRequired.description: Issued by Anganwadi / Health Centre with ANC checkup dates

documentsRequired.name: Mother's Aadhaar-Linked Bank Account Passbook
documentsRequired.description: Joint account not allowed; must be single account in mother's name

documentsRequired.name: Child Birth Certificate & Immunization Record
documentsRequired.description: Required for claiming subsequent installment

applicationProcedure.title: Register at Anganwadi or Online
applicationProcedure.detail: Apply online at https://pmmvy.wcd.gov.in or through your local Anganwadi Worker (ASHA/AWW).

applicationProcedure.title: Submit Mother's Profile
applicationProcedure.detail: Provide Aadhaar, MCP Card registration details, and LMP (Last Menstrual Period) date.

applicationProcedure.title: Verification by Supervisor
applicationProcedure.detail: Anganwadi supervisor / Medical Officer verifies the ANC records on PMMVY portal.

applicationProcedure.title: Direct Benefit Credit
applicationProcedure.detail: Installment amounts are processed through PFMS and deposited directly into mother's bank account.

troubleshootingTips.issue: Application rejected due to joint bank account
troubleshootingTips.solution: PMMVY guidelines strictly mandate a single savings bank account in the mother's name linked with Aadhaar NPCI mapper.

troubleshootingTips.issue: Delayed payment after child birth
troubleshootingTips.solution: Ensure child birth certificate and 14-week primary immunization records (BCG, OPV, DPT, Hepatitis-B) are uploaded by ASHA worker.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0
tagline: Deposit-free LPG connection, free first cylinder and stove for poor households
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
description: Ujjwala 2.0 provides deposit-free LPG connections to women belonging to poor households who do not have an existing LPG connection in the family. Along with the free gas connection, beneficiaries receive the first LPG cylinder refill free and a free two-burner gas stove (hotplate), plus an ongoing ₹300 subsidy per 14.2 kg cylinder for up to 12 refills a year.
benefits: Completely deposit-free LPG gas connection (security deposit of cylinder & regulator paid by Govt)
Free first 14.2 kg LPG cylinder refill
Free two-burner gas stove (hotplate)
Targeted subsidy of ₹300 per cylinder credited directly via DBT for up to 12 refills per year
Migrant workers require only a self-declaration for address proof without requiring local domicile
benefitAmount: Free connection + free 1st refill & stove + ₹300 subsidy/refill

troubleshootingTips.issue: LPG subsidy (₹300) not credited to bank

name: National Scholarship Portal Schemes (Pre & Post-Matric)
tagline: Centrally sponsored scholarships for school, college, and university students

Popular schemes include Post-Matric Scholarships for SC/ST/OBC/EBC/DNT students, Merit-cum-Means Scholarships, and Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College & University Students covering full tuition fee plus monthly maintenance allowance.
benefits: Tuition fee reimbursement up to 100% of institutional charges
Monthly maintenance allowance ranging from ₹500 to ₹1,500/month for day scholars and hostellers
Book grant, disability allowance, and thesis typing charges where applicable
Direct Benefit Transfer directly into student's own bank account via PFMS

Family annual income generally below ₹2.5 Lakh (varies slightly by specific scheme)
Minimum qualifying percentage (usually 50% or above in previous exam for merit schemes)

Studying in a recognized AISHE/UDISE registered educational institution

applicationProcedure.title: Upload Certificates

applicationProcedure.title: District & State Approval

troubleshootingTips.issue: NSP OTR Face Auth failing
troubleshootingTips.solution: Ensure Aadhaar FaceRD app by UIDAI is installed on Android phone. Use good natural lighting, remove glasses/mask, and blink when prompt appears.

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
tagline: Up to ₹78,000 direct subsidy to install rooftop solar panels and get 300 units free electricity
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
description: PM Surya Ghar provides direct financial subsidies to households to install grid-connected rooftop solar photovoltaic (PV) systems. Families save on monthly electricity bills, receive up to 300 units of free power each month, and can sell surplus power back to the local electricity distribution company (DISCOM).
benefits: ₹30,000 subsidy for 1 kW rooftop solar system
₹60,000 subsidy for 2 kW rooftop solar system
₹78,000 subsidy for 3 kW and higher systems
Up to 300 units of free electricity every month
Low-interest collateral-free bank loans (approx. 7% interest) available through JanSamarth portal
benefitAmount: Direct subsidy up to ₹78,000 + free electricity

specialConditions: Must own a residential house with suitable roof space for solar panels
Must have an active residential grid electricity connection from local DISCOM
Should not have availed solar subsidy earlier for the same premises

eligibilitySummary: Residential homeowner with valid electricity connection in applicant's name
Adequate unshaded roof area (approx. 100 sq. ft per 1 kW system)

documentsRequired.name: Recent Electricity Bill

troubleshootingTips.solution: Get the electricity connection name updated at your local DISCOM sub-division before applying, or provide a registered gift deed/succession certificate.

troubleshootingTips.issue: Net meter installation delayed by DISCOM
troubleshootingTips.solution: Escalate ticket on the PM Surya Ghar grievance portal or approach the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum (CGRF) of your DISCOM.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
tagline: Comprehensive crop insurance against drought, floods, pests & unseasonal rains at nominal premium (1.5% - 2%)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
description: PMFBY provides comprehensive insurance coverage and financial support to farmers suffering crop loss/damage arising from unforeseen non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest stages. Farmers pay only 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi food and oilseeds, and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops, with the remaining premium heavily subsidized by Government.
benefits: Comprehensive risk cover: prevented sowing, standing crop loss, post-harvest losses, and localized calamities (hailstorm, landslide, cloudburst)
Lowest farmer premium: only 1.5% to 2% of sum insured
Claim payouts processed directly into bank account through National Crop Insurance Portal (NCIP)
Mid-season adversity relief up to 25% immediate payout
benefitAmount: Up to 100% of sum insured per hectare

specialConditions: Growing notified crops in notified areas
Both loanee (KCC holders) and non-loanee farmers are eligible

eligibilitySummary: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops
Must enroll before crop cut-off dates for Kharif (typically July 31) or Rabi (typically Dec 31)

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar Card
documentsRequired.description: For identity verification

documentsRequired.name: Land Records (RoR / Khasra / Khatoni)
documentsRequired.description: Or tenant agreement / sowing certificate from Patwari

documentsRequired.name: Sowing Certificate / Crop Declaration
documentsRequired.description: Certified by Patwari / Village Agriculture Officer

applicationProcedure.detail: In case of localized disaster, report crop loss within 72 hours via Crop Insurance App or dial 14447.

troubleshootingTips.issue: Localized crop loss claim rejected
troubleshootingTips.solution: Natural calamities like hailstorms or waterlogging must be intimated within 72 hours of occurrence using the Crop Insurance App with geo-tagged photos.

name: Kisan Credit Card Scheme

With the Interest Subvention Scheme and Prompt Repayment Incentive (PRI), the net interest rate comes down to just 4% per annum.
benefits: Credit limit based on land holding and cropping pattern up to ₹3 Lakh at 4% effective interest
No collateral needed for loans up to ₹1.60 Lakh (extended to ₹3 Lakh in some banks)
Revolving cash credit account: withdraw as needed via KCC RuPay debit card
Includes built-in accidental insurance cover
Extended to animal husbandry, dairy, and fisheries farmers
benefitAmount: Credit up to ₹3,00,000 at 4% effective interest

specialConditions: All farmers—individuals/joint borrowers, tenant farmers, oral lessees, and sharecroppers

Engaged in crop cultivation, animal husbandry, poultry, or fisheries

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
tagline: ₹2 Lakh life insurance cover at just ₹436 per year premium

description: PMJJBY is a government-backed life insurance scheme providing ₹2,00,000 life insurance cover for death due to any cause. It is available to all bank/post office account holders aged 18 to 50 years with an annual premium of only ₹436 automatically debited from the bank account.
benefits: ₹2,00,000 death cover payable to nominee for death due to any medical or accidental cause
Affordable annual premium of only ₹436 (approx. ₹1.20 per day)
Auto-debit from savings account ensures seamless annual renewal
No medical examination required

specialConditions: Must have an active savings bank account or post office account
Age between 18 and 50 years (coverage extends up to age 55)

Give consent to join and enable auto-debit on or before May 31 each year

troubleshootingTips.issue: How nominee claims PMJJBY
troubleshootingTips.solution: Nominee submits death certificate, policy receipt, and claimant KYC to the bank branch where the deceased held the insured account. Claim is settled within 30 days.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
tagline: ₹2 Lakh accidental death & disability insurance for just ₹20 per year

₹2,00,000 for total irrecoverable loss of both eyes or both hands/feet
₹1,00,000 for total loss of sight of one eye or loss of one hand/foot
Incredibly low premium: just ₹20 per year

troubleshootingTips.issue: Policy lapsing due to insufficient funds
troubleshootingTips.solution: Ensure at least ₹20 balance in bank account in the month of May every year to avoid policy lapse.

name: Lakhpati Didi Initiative
tagline: Empowering Self-Help Group women to earn a sustainable annual income of ₹1 Lakh or more
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development / Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - NRLM

Community Investment Fund (CIF) & revolving credit up to ₹10-20 Lakh per SHG at concessional rates
Access to drone technology for crop spraying and fertilizer spreading (Namo Drone Didi)
Digital financial literacy and marketing assistance on Government e-Marketplace (GeM)
Mentorship from Community Resource Persons (CRPs)

applicationProcedure.detail: Collect your entitled quota of rice/wheat at ₹0 charge and obtain digital receipt.

name: Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana (MP)

ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Govt of Madhya Pradesh
description: Ladli Behna Yojana is a flagship scheme of Madhya Pradesh government providing ₹1,250 per month (increasing progressively to ₹3,000) directly into the Aadhaar-linked DBT bank account of eligible married, widowed, divorced, and abandoned women aged 21 to 60 years.
benefits: ₹1,250 direct cash benefit credited on the 10th of every month
Economic self-reliance and nutrition support for women
Direct Benefit Transfer without any middlemen

specialConditions: Must be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh
Married, widowed, divorced, or deserted women aged 21 to 60
Combined family annual income less than ₹2.5 Lakh and family agricultural land less than 5 acres

eligibilitySummary: Resident woman of Madhya Pradesh aged 21 to 60 years
Family income under ₹2.5 Lakh/year; land ownership under 5 acres
Not a government employee or income tax payer

documentsRequired.name: Samagra Family ID & Samagra Member ID
documentsRequired.description: With active Samagra e-KYC

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar Card
documentsRequired.description: Aadhaar must be linked to Samagra ID

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar-Linked DBT Active Bank Account
documentsRequired.description: In the woman's personal name

applicationProcedure.title: Complete Samagra e-KYC
applicationProcedure.detail: Ensure Samagra ID is linked with Aadhaar and mobile on https://samagra.gov.in.

applicationProcedure.title: Visit Gram Panchayat / Ward Camp
applicationProcedure.detail: Submit application during designated ward camps or Gram Panchayat center.

applicationProcedure.title: Live Photo & Biometric
applicationProcedure.detail: Camp operator captures live photograph and submits form on Ladli Behna portal.

applicationProcedure.title: Monthly Credit on 10th
applicationProcedure.detail: Benefit credited on 10th of every month directly to bank account.

troubleshootingTips.issue: DBT inactive in bank account
troubleshootingTips.solution: Visit your home bank branch and fill out the "Aadhaar NPCI DBT Enablement" form. Verify on the portal that DBT status turns Green.

name: Mukhyamantri Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana
tagline: Monthly direct financial support of ₹1,500 for women empowerment in Maharashtra
ministry: Department of Women & Child Development, Government of Maharashtra
description: A dedicated welfare scheme launched by the Maharashtra Government providing ₹1,500 per month directly into the Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts of eligible women between 21 and 65 years of age to promote economic self-reliance, better health, and financial security.
benefits: ₹1,500 per month (₹18,000 annually) direct financial assistance
Transferred directly via Aadhaar Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT)
Aimed at supporting nutrition, healthcare, and independent household expenses

specialConditions: Must be a resident of Maharashtra holding Domicile Certificate or 15-year Ration Card
Annual family income from all sources must not exceed ₹2.5 Lakh
Applicant or family member must not be an income tax payer or regular government employee

eligibilitySummary: Married, widowed, divorced, deserted, or unmarried women aged 21 to 65 years
Permanent resident of Maharashtra
Family annual income under ₹2.5 Lakh (or holding Yellow/Orange Ration Card)
Bank account must be in the applicant's own name and mapped to NPCI for Aadhaar DBT

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar Card
documentsRequired.description: Primary identity and age proof

documentsRequired.name: Domicile Certificate or 15-year School Leaving / Voter ID / Ration Card
documentsRequired.description: Proof of living in Maharashtra for 15+ years

documentsRequired.name: Income Certificate (Under ₹2.5 Lakh) or Yellow/Orange Ration Card
documentsRequired.description: Valid income proof; ration card accepted as alternative

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar-Seeded Bank Passbook
documentsRequired.description: Personal bank account with IFSC code; joint accounts not permitted

documentsRequired.name: Hamipatra (Self-Declaration Form)
documentsRequired.description: Signed undertaking declaring non-payment of income tax and single scheme benefit

applicationProcedure.title: Visit Portal or Nari Shakti Doot App
applicationProcedure.detail: Apply online at https://ladkibahin.maharashtra.gov.in or download the official Nari Shakti Doot mobile app.

applicationProcedure.title: Aadhaar OTP Registration
applicationProcedure.detail: Register using your active mobile number and verify via Aadhaar OTP.

applicationProcedure.title: Enter Personal & Family Details
applicationProcedure.detail: Provide marital status, address, family income details, and bank account details.

applicationProcedure.title: Upload Required Documents
applicationProcedure.detail: Upload clear scans of Aadhaar, Domicile/Ration Card, Income Certificate, and signed Hamipatra.

applicationProcedure.title: Submit & Track Application
applicationProcedure.detail: Submit application and save the Application ID. Offline applications can also be submitted at Anganwadi centers, Gram Panchayats, or Setu Suvidha Kendras.

troubleshootingTips.issue: Application rejected due to DBT Inactive
troubleshootingTips.solution: Check Aadhaar Bank Seeding status on UIDAI portal. Visit your bank branch immediately and request Aadhaar NPCI DBT mapping.

troubleshootingTips.issue: Domicile Certificate not available
troubleshootingTips.solution: The state government permits submission of a Ration Card issued at least 15 years ago, Voter ID, or School Leaving Certificate as residence proof.

name: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme
tagline: ₹2,000 monthly financial aid for female heads of families in Karnataka
ministry: Department of Women & Child Development, Government of Karnataka
description: Under the landmark Guarantee Schemes of Karnataka, Gruha Lakshmi provides ₹2,000 per month directly to woman heads of households to empower women, counter inflation, and support family welfare.
benefits: ₹2,000 per month direct income support
Transferred directly into bank account through Aadhaar DBT
Recognizes women's contributions to family welfare and household management

specialConditions: Must be designated as the Female Head of the Family on Antyodaya, BPL, or APL Ration Card
Applicant or her husband must not be an income tax payer or GST filer
Only one woman per household can receive the benefit

eligibilitySummary: Women heads of household residing in Karnataka
Name listed as Head of Family on BPL/AAY/APL ration card
Neither the woman nor her spouse can be an income tax or GST payer

documentsRequired.name: Ration Card (BPL / APL / Antyodaya)
documentsRequired.description: Must clearly list the applicant as the female head of family

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar Card of Applicant and Spouse
documentsRequired.description: For biometric and demographic verification

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar-Linked Bank Account Passbook
documentsRequired.description: Active savings account enabled for NPCI Direct Benefit Transfer

documentsRequired.name: Mobile Number Linked to Aadhaar
documentsRequired.description: To receive SMS confirmation and status updates

applicationProcedure.title: Check Ration Card Designation
applicationProcedure.detail: Ensure your ration card names you as head of family on https://ahara.kar.nic.in.

applicationProcedure.title: Visit Seva Sindhu or Citizen Center
applicationProcedure.detail: Apply online at https://sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in or visit Grama One, Karnataka One, or Bangalore One centers.

applicationProcedure.title: Biometric / OTP Verification
applicationProcedure.detail: Present your ration card number and complete Aadhaar OTP or biometric authentication.

applicationProcedure.title: Receive Acknowledgment
applicationProcedure.detail: Collect the computer-generated acknowledgment slip. Monthly transfers are made directly by the Karnataka state treasury.

troubleshootingTips.issue: Application blocked because head of family is listed as husband
troubleshootingTips.solution: Visit your nearest Food and Civil Supplies office or Grama One center to submit a request for changing the head of family on the ration card to the woman.

troubleshootingTips.issue: Payment not credited despite approval
troubleshootingTips.solution: Ensure Aadhaar is seeded with NPCI at your bank. If SMS is not received, call helpline 1902.

name: Yuva Nidhi Scheme
tagline: Monthly unemployment allowance of up to ₹3,000 for degree and diploma holders in Karnataka
ministry: Department of Skill Development & Livelihood, Government of Karnataka
description: Yuva Nidhi provides financial assistance of ₹3,000 per month for degree holders and ₹1,500 per month for diploma holders in Karnataka who remain unemployed after graduation, helping them manage competitive exam costs and living expenses for up to two years.
benefits: ₹3,000 per month for unemployed graduates
₹1,500 per month for unemployed diploma holders
Assistance provided for up to 24 months or until employment is secured
Free skill training and job placement opportunities through Karnataka Skill Development

specialConditions: Must have completed Degree or Diploma in Karnataka
Must have completed graduation at least 6 months prior and remained unemployed
Not applicable to candidates pursuing higher full-time studies or currently employed

eligibilitySummary: Degree or Diploma holder residing in Karnataka
Completed course at least 6 months ago without securing employment or higher education
Holds valid domicile of Karnataka for at least 6 years

documentsRequired.name: Degree or Diploma Passing Certificate & Marks Cards
documentsRequired.description: Academic proof from recognized Karnataka university or board

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar Card
documentsRequired.description: Identity proof linked with mobile number

documentsRequired.name: Karnataka Domicile Proof
documentsRequired.description: Study certificate showing at least 6 years of education in Karnataka

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar-Seeded Bank Passbook
documentsRequired.description: Must be enabled for DBT via NPCI

documentsRequired.name: Self-Declaration of Unemployment
documentsRequired.description: Standard declaration submitted on the portal each month

applicationProcedure.title: Visit Seva Sindhu Yuva Nidhi Portal
applicationProcedure.detail: Open https://sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in and click on Yuva Nidhi Scheme.

applicationProcedure.title: Enter University Registration Number
applicationProcedure.detail: Input your college registration or roll number to fetch degree verification from the NAD/State database.

applicationProcedure.title: Aadhaar Authentication
applicationProcedure.detail: Complete Aadhaar OTP verification to confirm personal identity.

applicationProcedure.title: Monthly Self-Certification
applicationProcedure.detail: Log in between the 25th and 30th of each month to self-certify continued unemployment to receive the monthly allowance.

troubleshootingTips.issue: Degree certificate data not found in portal
troubleshootingTips.solution: Contact your university/college examination branch to confirm that degree records have been uploaded to the Karnataka State Higher Education Council database.

name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai Thittam
tagline: ₹1,000 monthly basic income honoring women's unpaid labor in Tamil Nadu
ministry: Special Programme Implementation Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
description: A transformative universal basic income initiative by the Tamil Nadu government providing ₹1,000 every month directly to women heads of eligible families to recognize and compensate their lifelong unpaid household contributions and boost financial autonomy.
benefits: ₹1,000 per month (₹12,000 per year) direct cash benefit
Direct Benefit Transfer directly into bank account on the 15th of each month
Empowers women heads of families with discretionary financial decision-making power

specialConditions: Must be recognized as Woman Head of Family on Smart Family Ration Card
Annual family income must be less than ₹2.5 Lakh
Family electricity consumption should be less than 3,600 units per year
Family landholding must be below 5 acres (wetland) or 10 acres (dryland)

eligibilitySummary: Women heads of household in Tamil Nadu aged 21 and above
Family income under ₹2.5 Lakh per year
Electricity consumption under 3,600 kWh/year and landholding below 5 acres wetland
No family member should be a government employee, pensioner, or income tax payer

documentsRequired.name: Smart Family Ration Card
documentsRequired.description: Lists applicant as the female head of family

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar Card
documentsRequired.description: Identity and biometric authentication

documentsRequired.name: Electricity Consumer Card / Number
documentsRequired.description: TANGEDCO consumer connection number for power usage verification

documentsRequired.name: Bank Passbook (Aadhaar linked)
documentsRequired.description: To receive monthly DBT payment

applicationProcedure.title: Collect Token & Application Form
applicationProcedure.detail: Ration shop volunteers distribute tokens and application forms to eligible doorsteps.

applicationProcedure.title: Visit Designated Special Camp
applicationProcedure.detail: Attend the designated camp at your local school or community hall as per your token schedule.

applicationProcedure.title: Biometric Registration
applicationProcedure.detail: Camp operator scans Smart Card, Aadhaar, and takes biometric fingerprint verification.

applicationProcedure.title: SMS Approval Notification
applicationProcedure.detail: Receive approval SMS from Tamil Nadu e-Governance Agency. ₹1,000 is credited on the 15th of each month.

troubleshootingTips.issue: Application rejected due to electricity consumption calculation
troubleshootingTips.solution: File an appeal online through https://kmut.tn.gov.in within 30 days or visit the Revenue Divisional Officer (RDO) office.

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana
tagline: Up to ₹25,000 educational and healthcare grant for girl children in UP
ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
description: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana provides conditional financial grants totaling ₹25,000 across 6 life stages of a girl child (birth, immunization, Class 1, Class 6, Class 9, and graduation/diploma admission) to eradicate female foeticide and promote girls' higher education.
benefits: Total package of ₹25,000 transferred in 6 stages directly into the bank account
Stage 1 (Birth): ₹5,000 | Stage 2 (Immunization): ₹2,000
Stage 3 (Class 1 admission): ₹3,000 | Stage 4 (Class 6 admission): ₹3,000
Stage 5 (Class 9 admission): ₹5,000 | Stage 6 (Degree/Diploma admission): ₹7,000

specialConditions: Family must be permanent residents of Uttar Pradesh
Annual family income from all sources must not exceed ₹3 Lakh
Maximum two girl children per family are eligible

eligibilitySummary: Girl children born and residing in Uttar Pradesh
Family income under ₹3 Lakh per year
Up to 2 girls per family (or 3 if twin girls born on second delivery)

documentsRequired.name: Birth Certificate of Girl Child
documentsRequired.description: Issued by Nagar Nigam / Gram Panchayat

documentsRequired.name: UP Domicile / Residence Certificate
documentsRequired.description: Proof of permanent residence in Uttar Pradesh

documentsRequired.name: Income Certificate (Family income < ₹3 Lakh)
documentsRequired.description: Issued by competent Tehsildar

documentsRequired.name: School / College Admission Certificate
documentsRequired.description: For school or college milestone stages

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar Card of Parents and Girl
documentsRequired.description: For identity verification

documentsRequired.name: Joint or Sole Bank Account Passbook
documentsRequired.description: Enabled for DBT to receive installment payments

applicationProcedure.title: Visit MKSY Portal
applicationProcedure.detail: Open https://mksy.up.gov.in and click on "Citizen Service Portal - Apply Here".

applicationProcedure.title: Citizen Registration
applicationProcedure.detail: Register with mobile number, verify OTP, and create citizen login credentials.

applicationProcedure.title: Add Girl Child & Select Category
applicationProcedure.detail: Add beneficiary details and choose the milestone stage applying for (Stage 1 to 6).

applicationProcedure.title: Upload Certificates & Submit
applicationProcedure.detail: Upload Birth, Income, Domicile, and Admission certificates in PDF format.

applicationProcedure.title: BDO / SDM Verification
applicationProcedure.detail: Application is verified by Block Development Officer and approved by District Probation Officer.

troubleshootingTips.issue: Delay in Stage 6 scholarship disbursement
troubleshootingTips.solution: Ensure college enrollment receipt and fee challan are clearly legible and stamped by college principal.

name: Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income Augmentation
tagline: Direct financial assistance of ₹10,000/year for farmers and landless cultivators in Odisha
ministry: Department of Agriculture & Farmers' Empowerment, Government of Odisha
description: KALIA is an inclusive agricultural welfare package in Odisha that covers small farmers, marginal cultivators, sharecroppers, and landless agricultural households, providing direct income assistance, allied livelihood funding, and interest-free crop loans.
benefits: ₹10,000 per year (₹4,000 per Kharif and Rabi season) for small & marginal farmers
₹12,500 one-time financial aid for landless agricultural households for allied units (goat rearing, duckery, mushroom, etc.)
Life insurance cover of ₹2 Lakh and personal accident cover of ₹2 Lakh
Interest-free crop loans up to ₹1 Lakh through primary cooperative societies

specialConditions: Small and marginal farmers holding 1 to 5 acres of agricultural land, or landless agricultural households
Resident of Odisha
Excludes institutional landholders, government employees, and income tax payers

eligibilitySummary: Small and marginal farmers or landless agricultural laborers in Odisha
Resident of Odisha with valid Aadhaar
Covers both landowning farmers and sharecroppers/landless workers

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar Card
documentsRequired.description: Primary ID for biometric e-KYC

documentsRequired.name: Land Record (RoR / Patta) or MGNREGA Job Card
documentsRequired.description: Land patta for cultivators; Job card for landless laborers

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar-Linked Bank Account Passbook
documentsRequired.description: Direct transfer through state DBT portal

documentsRequired.name: Ration Card
documentsRequired.description: Proof of family composition in Odisha

applicationProcedure.title: Visit KALIA Portal
applicationProcedure.detail: Open https://kalia.odisha.gov.in and click on "Online Grievance / Application Application Form".

applicationProcedure.title: Select Farmer Category
applicationProcedure.detail: Choose Small/Marginal Farmer or Landless Agricultural Household.

applicationProcedure.title: Aadhaar OTP Verification
applicationProcedure.detail: Authenticate using Aadhaar registered mobile number.

applicationProcedure.title: Submit Land or Livelihood Details
applicationProcedure.detail: Enter village, GP, plot details or MGNREGA job card number.

applicationProcedure.title: Complete e-KYC
applicationProcedure.detail: Complete e-KYC online or via Mo Seva Kendra.

troubleshootingTips.issue: e-KYC incomplete on KALIA portal
troubleshootingTips.solution: Visit any Mo Seva Kendra or Common Service Center (CSC) in Odisha with your Aadhaar for biometric authentication.

name: Kanyashree Prakalpa
tagline: Annual scholarship and ₹25,000 one-time grant empowering adolescent girls in West Bengal
ministry: Department of Women & Child Development & Social Welfare, Government of West Bengal
description: United Nations Public Service Award-winning conditional cash transfer scheme in West Bengal incentivizing schooling for teenage girls and preventing early child marriage through annual educational scholarships and a ₹25,000 grant upon completing 18 years unmarried.
benefits: K1 Scheme: ₹1,000 annual scholarship for unmarried girls aged 13-18 enrolled in classes 8-12
K2 Scheme: One-time grant of ₹25,000 when the girl turns 18 years, remains unmarried, and is in formal education
K3 Scheme: Subsidized higher education stipends for postgraduate studies in Science, Arts, and Commerce

specialConditions: Must be unmarried and enrolled in recognized school, college, or open university in West Bengal
Resident of West Bengal
Income ceiling is waived for girls with disabilities, orphans, or inmates of government homes

eligibilitySummary: Unmarried girls aged 13 to 19 years studying in recognized institutions in West Bengal
Regular attendance in school or college
Holds individual bank account in her own name

documentsRequired.name: Birth Certificate
documentsRequired.description: Issued by hospital or municipal/Panchayat authority

documentsRequired.name: Unmarried Declaration Certificate
documentsRequired.description: Self-declaration signed by girl and parents/guardian

documentsRequired.name: School Enrollment Certificate
documentsRequired.description: Head of Institution certificate confirming class and admission

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar Card
documentsRequired.description: For demographic verification

documentsRequired.name: Bank Passbook in Girl's Sole Name
documentsRequired.description: Must have IFSC code; joint accounts not accepted

applicationProcedure.title: Obtain Form from School
applicationProcedure.detail: Application forms (K1/K2) are distributed free of cost by school/college authorities.

applicationProcedure.title: Attach Required Documents
applicationProcedure.detail: Attach copies of Birth certificate, unmarried declaration, and bank passbook.

applicationProcedure.title: School Verification & Data Entry
applicationProcedure.detail: School headmaster/teacher uploads student records to the online Kanyashree portal.

applicationProcedure.title: Receive Kanyashree ID & Direct Credit
applicationProcedure.detail: Student receives a unique 20-digit Kanyashree ID. Grant is credited directly via state treasury DBT.

troubleshootingTips.issue: K2 application rejected due to age calculation
troubleshootingTips.solution: The applicant must be between 18 and 19 years on the date of submitting the K2 form. Ensure Birth Certificate matches school registration exactly.

name: Lakshmir Bhandar Scheme
tagline: Monthly basic income support of up to ₹1,200 for women aged 25-60 in West Bengal
ministry: Department of Women & Child Development & Social Welfare, Government of West Bengal
description: Lakshmir Bhandar provides monthly unconditional financial assistance of ₹1,200 for SC/ST women and ₹1,000 for General category women aged 25 to 60 years in West Bengal, recognizing female heads of families and fostering women's financial inclusion.
benefits: ₹1,200 per month for SC/ST female beneficiaries
₹1,000 per month for General & OBC female beneficiaries
Direct monthly deposit via Aadhaar DBT into beneficiary's bank account
Covers almost all non-government employed adult women in West Bengal

specialConditions: Must be a permanent female resident of West Bengal aged 25 to 60 years
Must possess a Swasthya Sathi health scheme card
Excludes permanent government employees and recipients of regular government pensions

eligibilitySummary: Women residents of West Bengal aged 25 to 60 years
Holder of Swasthya Sathi family card
Not employed in government sector or receiving government pension

documentsRequired.name: Swasthya Sathi Card
documentsRequired.description: Mandatory primary document for enrollment

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar Card
documentsRequired.description: Identity and age verification

documentsRequired.name: SC / ST Caste Certificate
documentsRequired.description: Required to receive enhanced ₹1,200 benefit; not required for General

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar-Linked Bank Account Passbook
documentsRequired.description: Bank account in beneficiary's personal name

documentsRequired.name: Passport Size Photograph
documentsRequired.description: Two recent color photos for application form

applicationProcedure.title: Visit Duare Sarkar Camp
applicationProcedure.detail: Collect the free application form at your local Duare Sarkar camp or Block Development Office (BDO).

applicationProcedure.title: Fill Form & Attach Swasthya Sathi Copy
applicationProcedure.detail: Fill details and attach self-attested photocopies of Swasthya Sathi card, Aadhaar, and bank passbook.

applicationProcedure.title: Camp Data Entry & Receipt
applicationProcedure.detail: Officials scan documents and issue an official acknowledgment slip with Application ID.

applicationProcedure.title: Monthly Credit via Treasury
applicationProcedure.detail: Benefit is credited directly to the Aadhaar-linked bank account every month.

troubleshootingTips.issue: Swasthya Sathi card name mismatch with Aadhaar
troubleshootingTips.solution: Visit your local BDO or municipality health cell to update the name on your Swasthya Sathi card before applying.

name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Kalyan Yojana
tagline: Additional ₹6,000/year state grant for PM-KISAN beneficiary farmers in Madhya Pradesh
ministry: Revenue Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh
description: Madhya Pradesh government scheme providing an additional ₹6,000 per year in three installments to farmer families who are already beneficiaries of the Central PM-KISAN scheme, taking the total annual farmer assistance to ₹12,000 per year.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year top-up grant directly from MP state treasury
Paid in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 each
Combined with Central PM-KISAN (₹6,000), total farmer assistance reaches ₹12,000 per year
Direct Benefit Transfer without intermediary fees

specialConditions: Must already be registered and verified as an eligible beneficiary under Central PM-KISAN
Must hold cultivable agricultural land in Madhya Pradesh in the applicant's name
Must have Samagra ID linked to Aadhaar and land records

eligibilitySummary: Cultivating farmers in Madhya Pradesh receiving Central PM-KISAN
Cultivable land registered in applicant's name in MP land records
Samagra e-KYC and land-linking completed on SAARA portal

documentsRequired.name: PM-KISAN Registration Number / Aadhaar Card
documentsRequired.description: Proof of active PM-KISAN beneficiary status

documentsRequired.name: Samagra ID
documentsRequired.description: 9-digit individual Samagra ID in MP

documentsRequired.name: Land Record (Khatauni / Khasra)
documentsRequired.description: Updated MP land record

documentsRequired.name: Aadhaar-Seeded Bank Passbook
documentsRequired.description: Must have active NPCI DBT seeding

applicationProcedure.title: Verify PM-KISAN Status
applicationProcedure.detail: Ensure your Central PM-KISAN beneficiary status is Active on https://pmkisan.gov.in.

applicationProcedure.title: Link Samagra with Land on SAARA
applicationProcedure.detail: Visit https://saara.mp.gov.in or contact your local Patwari to link your Samagra ID with your Khasra land numbers.

applicationProcedure.title: Patwari Physical Verification
applicationProcedure.detail: Patwari verifies land ownership records on the SAARA portal.

applicationProcedure.title: Automatic DBT Credit
applicationProcedure.detail: Once approved, the state disbursement of ₹2,000 is credited three times a year directly to your Aadhaar-linked account.

troubleshootingTips.issue: PM-KISAN active but Kisan Kalyan not received
troubleshootingTips.solution: Contact your Halqa Patwari to complete Samagra-Aadhaar-Khasra e-KYC mapping on the SAARA portal.
